info.title: PayBridge API
info.description: Local-only demo API. Header role switch (not security). Base URL http://localhost:8000. Rate limit: none.

get.description: No headers required. Roles: none (public). Rate limit: none.

503.description: Database check failed (not the error envelope): {"status":"error","database":"error"}

get.summary: List demo users for the picker
get.description: No headers required. Roles: none (public). Rate limit: none.

post.description: Idempotency expiry: once 24 h (IDEMPOTENCY_TTL_SECONDS = 86400) have elapsed since the original payment's created_at, the (customer_id, key) slot is lazily released inside the create transaction and the same key creates a NEW payment (202) regardless of payload (hash not compared); the original payment is unchanged except idempotency_released_at. A replay never extends the window. Routing: 100..10,000,000 UPI; ..20,000,000 IMPS; ..50,000,000 NEFT; above RTGS. Roles: customer. Rate limit: none.

parameters.name: X-Role
parameters.description: customer|ops|admin

parameters.name: X-Customer-Id
parameters.description: Required when X-Role=customer; ops/admin may omit

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: 1-128 chars, UUID in the UI. Scoped per customer

202.description: New payment created in state CREATED; rail chosen by amount

200.description: Replay: same (customer_id, key) and same payload within 24 h of the ORIGINAL payment's created_at (fixed window, not sliding). Returns the original payment. Header Idempotent-Replay: true

401.description: UNAUTHENTICATED: Missing or unknown X-Role, or invalid X-Customer-Id

409.description: IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_CONFLICT: Same key, different payload, within the 24 h window

422.description: AMOUNT_BELOW_MINIMUM: amount_paise < 100 (fields[0].field = amount_paise); VALIDATION_ERROR: Missing/invalid Idempotency-Key (field Idempotency-Key), empty or >140 char beneficiary, non-integer amount_paise
